notes.title: The Final Flip – Launch Date Locked!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey there![/b]    It’s official, Vextorial launches in just 4 weeks!  This isn’t just another puzzle game. In Vextorial, you’ll:[/p][p]🔹 Shift between 2D and 3D perspectives to uncover paths hidden in plain sight[/p][p]🔹 Bend gravity itself to forge impossible routes through ancient ruins[/p][p]🔹 Unravel a surreal mystery about memory, identity, and a brother you never had

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087239/5812da72e7fe0c9104dc6f2d25b85e5b5d260f9d.gif"][/img][/p][p]Players and press who’ve tried it have already called it “mind-bending” and “unlike anything else.” With awards under its belt and glowing early reviews, Vextorial is shaping up to be one of the most unique puzzle adventures of the year.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087239/a0058f9809b3093ccd5da3137ec496c2e6839ee2.gif"][/img]If you love games that challenge the way you think about space and perspective, this is one you won’t want to miss.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087239/b53f5aab401aa6790e774413a695f25d5362bff3.gif"][/img][/p][p]👉 Wishlist Vextorial now to be notified the moment it launches and join us when reality flips.  In a game about changing perspectives, discover people’s perspectives on change.  

See you in The Bridge  
- DInk [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087239/2e37934be97ff3aceb2452b8ea70b93471ad1d79.png"][/img][/p]
